title: Harden websocket auth and algo event reconciliation
completion_summary: Hardened WS ack handling and added algoexecutionreport subscription support
acceptance_criteria: Private websocket auth and subscribe acknowledgement handling matches current Orderly success payloads and failure paths are surfaced cleanly.
Algo execution events are consumed and reconciled into the Orderly order model without relying on REST polling alone.
Websocket topic or payload parsing changes stay isolated to websocket or auth-related modules to avoid cross-task merge conflicts.
Validation steps include a reproducible way to verify auth acknowledgement parsing and algo event mapping in the test task.
